gemini_summary.growth_hypothesis: Calmer background and stronger subject presence may support attention and emotional focus; retention/watch-time impact requires later measured A/B data.
gemini_summary.uncertainty: Gemini viewed a compressed rendition through an uncalibrated surface and could not verify true HDR peak luminance or gamut.
gemini_summary.visually_observed: Calmer variants generally reduce background dominance; richer-subject variants appear warmer and more present.
